name: Taffy
notes: New MIDI out section in Settings. Chords, bass and chimes can each play on the built-in sound or be sent as MIDI on a channel from 1 to 16 to other apps on the phone (Taffy shows up as a MIDI source called Taffy). Choosing a MIDI channel mutes the built-in sound for that part, so you can send the chords to another synth and keep the chimes in Taffy.
